bestTimeToVisit.title: Shoulder seasons are typically easiest in Columbia
bullets: Spring and fall usually offer comfortable weather and smoother logistics.

faq.q: How many days should I plan for Columbia?
faq.a: Two to three days is enough for core Columbia highlights plus one or two local experiences.

faq.q: Should I book tours ahead in Columbia?
faq.a: Yes—advance booking is recommended for weekends, holidays, and top-rated operators.
